Klaviyo is built for mid-market, agencies, enterprise, shareholders… everyone.

Start your free trial.

cards.body:
“Find customers who bought twice but haven’t ordered in 90 days.”

You know who you want to reach. Now see how to turn that sentence into a tagged audience.

On this free advanced webinar, Marcus and Josh show you how to use Claude with Shopify and Drip to identify customers using purchase history and email engagement, then tag them in your email platform.

👉 Repeat buyers who’ve gone quiet. 
👉 Subscribers who keep opening but never buy. 
👉 VIPs you want to give early access.

Then take it further: use what you know about that audience to choose products and design an email for them.

Thursday, October 8 · Free · Can’t make it live? Register and we’ll send the replay.
